blocks.title: Material
blocks.text: Material koi bhi maddah ya maddon ka amezah (mixture) hai jo rozmarra ya sanati ahmiyat ki kisi tabai cheez ko banata hai, maslan plastics, metals, ceramics aur tameerati material.

Materials ki mufeed thermal, mechanical (maslan sakhti aur lachak, elasticity) aur kimiyai khasiyatein hoti hain. Yeh khasiyatein material ki banawat (composition), us ke kimiyai bonds ki nau'iyat aur us ki andaruni chhoti banawat (microstructure) se samjhi jati hain. Kisi khaas kaam ke liye material us ki tabai, kimiyai, mechanical, electrical aur thermal khasiyaton ke mutabiq chuna jata hai. Bari qismein metals aur alloys, ceramics, polymers, composites aur semiconductors hain.

blocks.alt: Paanch rangeen khane: Metals and alloys (steel, aluminium), Ceramics (bricks, glass), Polymers (plastics, rubber), Composites (fibreglass) aur Semiconductors (Si, GaAs, GaN).
blocks.caption: Materials ki paanch qismein aur un ki misalein (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Kaun si teen cheezein material ki khasiyatein samajhne mein madad deti hain?
blocks.explanation: Us ki banawat (composition), us ke kimiyai bonds ki nau'iyat aur us ki microstructure.

items: Material rozmarra ya sanati ahmiyat ki cheez banata hai.
Khasiyatein banawat, bonding aur microstructure par munhasir.
